name: synthetic-india
description: Synthetic client replies written for the Indian cross-border freelancer context: overseas clients (US, UK, Australia, Canada, Singapore, UAE) replying about an overdue PayPal invoice from an India-based freelancer. Includes Indian business English used by Gulf and Asia-based agencies. Synthetic, not collected from real clients; reviewed for authenticity by an India-based author.

messages: Apologies Rohan, this slipped through the cracks during our launch week. Could you resend the payment link? I can't find the original email.
Sorry Priya, I was travelling and completely missed your earlier emails. Paying it now.
Ah, I was sure I'd already set this up. My mistake, I never actually approved it in PayPal. Doing it now.
The invoice is with our finance team. They process vendor payments in the monthly run once the CFO signs off.
Dear Ankit, the invoice has been forwarded to our accounts department for approval. Will revert once it is processed. Kindly bear with us.
Our AP team needs a PO number on the invoice before it can enter the approval queue. Once that's added it goes to my manager for sign-off.
Honestly, we're waiting on our seed round to close and cash is tight this month. Could we do half now and the rest in December?
Things are slow on our side since one of our own clients stopped paying. Can you give us a few weeks? We will definitely pay.
Is there any way to split this into three payments? Our budget was cut this quarter.
Before we pay: the mobile site still breaks on Safari and the checkout page doesn't match the Figma. We can't sign this off as complete.
We agreed on 40 hours, not 52. Please revise the invoice to the agreed amount and we'll pay that.
Money is tight for us anyway, but more importantly the copy has typos throughout and two pages are missing. I'm not paying for unfinished work.
Hi, I'm the marketing lead and don't handle payments. Please send invoices to billing@northpeak.example.
Mark left the company last month. Please reach out to our new operations manager, Li Wei, at liwei@harbourapps.example.
This email ID is not monitored for payments. Kindly send the invoice to accounts@desertpixel.example and do the needful.
Payment will go out next Monday, the 9th.
We pay suppliers on the 15th, so you'll see it then.
Will clear it positively by the end of this month.
No worries, I'll pay it this Friday.
We paid this on Monday through PayPal. Can you check again? I have the receipt.
Our bank sent a wire transfer last week, reference CLD-0042. It should be with you by now.
Already done from our side. Please check your PayPal balance.
Noted, thanks.
Let me look into this and revert.
cases.note: Indian business English for 'get back to you'. No reason or date given.

messages: PayPal fees are quite high on our side. Can we pay through Wise instead? Send me your bank details.
cases.note: Payment-rail request, not a late reason. Freelancer should decide; agent must not share bank details.

messages: Can you also send a quote for phase two while you're at it?
